question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Which couple do you like more?
What do you think of Jessica now?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I call it `Purple Kiss.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I call it [color=#e23b3b][i]Purple Kiss.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What?! Ben, you gave Jessica `my` perfume for Secret Santa?
nodes.text_bbcode: What?! Ben, you gave Jessica [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] perfume for Secret Santa?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Yes?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But you told me that you made this perfume especially with me in mind!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You told me it was special! And then you... You just give it to her?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Only because `you` liked it so much!
nodes.text_bbcode: Only because [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] liked it so much!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This couldn't have gone better if I'd planned it! This is `way` better than my sweater idea!
nodes.text_bbcode: This couldn't have gone better if I'd planned it! This is [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] better than my sweater idea!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I can't believe this!
Denni storms off.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Denni, wait! I... I don't understand...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Smelly?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I mean, it's just such an... Unusual combination of smells...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm getting the feeling you don't like it.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No! It's not like that at all.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It smells exactly like what would happen if you married skinny jeans and cinnamon buns.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You don't like skinny jeans or cinammon buns. Listen, I can tell you don't like it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry it's not really your thing, but...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess I did technically make it for Denni.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I love the coffee and cinnamon smells I'm getting. And is that the smell of music?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah! That's exactly what I was going for!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This is so perfect! I can't believe you'd give me something that suited me so well!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You can't smell it yet, but the floral base note really sells it.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, I love it! It's great! Thank you for such a thoughtful present!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Technically, you have Denni to thank for it.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh... It's so... So...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Can't find the right words, huh?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's so great I'm speechless?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's all right if you don't like it...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess I did technically make it for Denni.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Thank you, cheerleaders. And Jessica's right. Before you leave for winter break, find your Secret Santa and give them your final gift!
Around the room, Jessica sees other students give out their Secret Santa presents.
Brendan comes over to the cheerleaders and hands Amanda two packages.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Merry Christmas, Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Brendan, `you` were my Secret Santa! I had no idea!
nodes.text_bbcode: Brendan, [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] were my Secret Santa! I had no idea!

nodes.text: Amanda unwraps both of her gifts and looks at them one at a time.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: A stuffed puppy dog? I love soft and furry things! And you bought me a sunflower that sings! That's sunny `and` funny! Thank you!
nodes.text_bbcode: A stuffed puppy dog? I love soft and furry things! And you bought me a sunflower that sings! That's sunny [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] funny! Thank you!

nodes.text: Amanda hugs Brendan.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Now tell me, before I give Nicole her gift... How are things with Crendan?
Nearby, Hector approaches $ZOE and hands her a bright gift bag.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're my Secret Santa? I hope I wasn't too much trouble. Hee hee!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Not for a man of my gift-giving expertise.
She opens the bag.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Hector! A music box? It's so pretty! How did you ever think of that?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Thought you'd appreciate something girly with a Hector flair to it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I love it. It's perfect!
And across the room, Howard finds Taylor and hands her a bright, golden box.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Merry Christmas, Taylor! I, uh, hope you like your gift...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'd better.
Taylor opens the gift and pulls out a piece of jewelry.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's... It's a silver bracelet with an arrow-through-the-heart charm.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I like jewelry... And the charm reminds me of this dumb game I've been playing with the nerds.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This is... Actually not terrible.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm glad you liked it. I had a nightmare that I'd given you the wrong gift, and you had an identity crisis and created the misfits table.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh, that sounds `so` not like me.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh, that sounds [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] not like me.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Thanks for the gift, Howard.
On her side of the room, Jessica finds Denni and casually bumps into her.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sorry, Denni. I didn't see you there.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, that's okay.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You look like you're in a good mood. Get any good gifts lately? Any very warm, very woolen gifts?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That's... Oddly specific. All I got recently was Ben's gift. And I loved it! It makes me feel like we're closer than ever.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh... I see.
Ben comes up to Jessica and Denni.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, just the two girls I was looking for.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Denni, you look great.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And Jessica, I have something for you. Merry Christmas.
Ben hands Jessica a box.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I can't wait to see what's inside. All the gifts you've given me before have been amazing!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Were they? I wasn't sure if you really liked them, or if you were just being nice.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Are you kidding? No way! They were totes awesome!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, here's hoping this one is too.
Jessica opens it and finds a bottle of perfume. She tests some on her wrist and sniffs it.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh, this perfume spells like a moldy vintage bakery. And I don't even know what that is!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But... This is from Ben... Which means I have to compliment it!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Wow, Ben, this perfume smells so... So...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh... Give me an 'L' for, uh, 'Looks great'!
Jessica gives Nicole a hard glare.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Uh... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Oh! Give me an 'O' for 'Outstanding'!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Give me a 'U' for 'Unique'!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And give me an 'S' for 'Single'!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `J-E-A-L-O-U-S!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]J-E-A-L-O-U-S![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What does that spell? `Jealous!` Aren't you jealous because we're having so much fun up here?
nodes.text_bbcode: What does that spell? [color=#3b78e2][i]Jealous![/i][/color] Aren't you jealous because we're having so much fun up here?

nodes.text: The students cheer. Jessica winks at Ben who waves back.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Get ready to come on down and give your gifts to your Secret Santa!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh... Give me an 'N' for 'Normal'?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Uh... Uh... Give me an 'S' for 'Silly'?
The last two cheerleaders, Maria and Hector, look at each other and shrug. Jessica steps up!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `J-E-A-N-S!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]J-E-A-N-S![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What does that spell? `Jeans!` And... Um...
nodes.text_bbcode: What does that spell? [color=#3b78e2][i]Jeans![/i][/color] And... Um...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't we look good in jeans? I mean, not right now, but in general?
The students stare blankly at the cheerleaders. Ben looks at his feet. Jessica throws a pom-pom down.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Isn't it time for the Secret Santa Gift Exchange now?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh... Give me an 'S' for 'Super hot'!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Uh... Uh... Give me a 'Y' for 'Yellow'?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Um... Give me an 'X' for 'Xylophone'!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh... Give me an 'S' for 'Striped'?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `J-E-A-S-Y-X-S!` What does that spell?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]J-E-A-S-Y-X-S![/i][/color] What does that spell?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What `does` that spell?
nodes.text_bbcode: What [color=#3b78e2][i]does[/i][/color] that spell?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I'm not quite sure...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Is that a foreign word?
In the crowd, Brendan turns to Dex with a concerned look on his face...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Jeasyxs the Destroyer... The beast spoken of in the ancient scrolls of `Ogres and Elves...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Jeasyxs the Destroyer... The beast spoken of in the ancient scrolls of [color=#e23b3b][i]Ogres and Elves...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: The prophecies are coming true! Aiiiiiieeee!
Dex runs out of the room, screaming.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: That was weird.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh, this is a `D-I-S-A-S-T-E-R!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh, this is a [color=#3b78e2][i]D-I-S-A-S-T-E-R!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The students stare blankly at the cheerleaders. Jessica sees Ben look at his feet and throws a pom-pom down.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Isn't it time for the Secret Santa Gift Exchange now?
At that moment, a bell rings, and the student body floods into the auditorium. Justin takes his place at the podium.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hello, Centerscore! Welcome to the big reveal of the Secret Santa Gift Exchange!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Before you storm down here and exchange your Secret Santa gifts, the cheerleaders will give their last performance before the end of the year!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Cheerleaders?
Jessica leads her team onto the gym floor. They huddle for a moment.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Remember, we're spelling out my name. I'm in the middle, with the hottest girl cheerleaders next to me. That means you, Amanda and Nicole.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Everyone knows what letter they're taking?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I have J!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I have E!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: And I have A!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: For the last time, Amanda, you're 'S'! Don't screw this up!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You got it!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So after Amanda goes, I say, `'S'.` Nicole is 'I', Maria is 'C', and Hector is 'A'!
nodes.text_bbcode: So after Amanda goes, I say, [color=#3b78e2][i]'S'.[/i][/color] Nicole is 'I', Maria is 'C', and Hector is 'A'!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ready? Let's do this!
Everyone moves into position. Nicole flips a switch on a stereo system, and music blasts! The cheerleaders perform a few flips, and then line up in the center!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This is it! I have to look good for Ben. And what better way to do that by being the center of attention and having all the hot girls next to me?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Give me a 'J' for 'Joyful'!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Give me an 'E' for 'Exciting'!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Give me an 'A' for 'Amanda'!
The cheerleaders look at each other and then at Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Ugh!` I'm up! And we've spelled J-E-A...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ugh![/i][/color] I'm up! And we've spelled J-E-A...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You're saying I'm not?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I don't need Colt at my place to make it a party!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm a one-man party! A one-of-a-kind celebration machine! An award-winning one-act play!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And you know what? I'll prove it to you.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No, wait... You don't have to do that...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Now you're just trying to make me feel better. I know a challenge when I see one.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I love challenges! One time, I tried to see if I could eat a hundred marshmallows at once!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: When I woke up I was in the hospital!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: ...What does that have to do with Colt?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Nothing!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So... Can Colt come to your party?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I don't know if I want him there...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Come on. Colt's your friend, isn't he?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: And when it's the holidays, you want to be surrounded by friends, right?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: All right, fine. But only because he's in town for one week.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Colt's in.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And isn't that the time to get together with friends and let past stuff go?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, you're right.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Besides how often do you get to see each other?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: And how often do we even get to see someone so hot? Am I right?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! I love Pony!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: All right. Colt's in.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Excellent.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This entire perfume thing isn't a big deal.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And if you go up to her and keep talking about it, it's going to seem like an even bigger deal than it is.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There is some logic to that...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Look, Ben, think about it. You made her this really nice gift and decided, as a really sweet gesture, that you were going to also give it to me.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: She should be glad you're such a thoughtful guy. She really has no reason to be upset.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: If I were you, I'd tell her you were just being charitable and that she shouldn't worry so much.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm sure once you explain to her that she's wrong to feel the way she does, she'll forgive you right away.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Do you think that's really enough to fix everything?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You also might want to tell her she seems like she's extra emotional today. Girls like it when you notice small details like that.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Girls do like small details! Thanks, Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So when are you going to talk to Denni?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Now, I guess. Unless you think that's a bad idea.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's a terrible idea, Ben! Girls like to be alone when they're upset, so they can calm down.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So when should I talk to her?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well... Is she coming to Hector's party?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We talked about going... She can only stay for a couple hours before she leaves for her plane flight.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm sure you'll see her at the party. And trust me, you should talk to her then.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't think I'm up to going to a party...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You will when you and Denni make up. Just wait until then.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, and Ben, come a little late. For appearances. No one cool gets to a party until at least twenty minutes in...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That should give me enough time to get to Denni first!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, sure. Thanks for all your help. I'll see you at Hector's.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah! See you there!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I think I know why you did it, and I'm okay with that.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So you forgive me?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Only if you'll forgive me.
Ben and Denni start kissing...
And keep kissing...
Jessica pops a mint into her mouth.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Okay, enough of that! That is, like, so gross!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I thought you were supposed to be mad at each other!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Not anymore. I couldn't bear to be mad at Denni.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And I couldn't bear to be mad at Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks for your advice, Jessica. It got me to thinking more about how I could be a better boyfriend.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yes, thank you, Jessica. You're the reason we decided to stay together...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Forever.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Noooooooooo!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Noooooooooo!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: This can't be how it ends! Try again and help Jessica break this happy couple up!
Jessica leans forward to kiss Ben... And misses, planting a firm smooch on the railing of the porch!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ewww! Gross! Blech!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Pine wood does not taste good!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Jessica... Were you trying to kiss me?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It looked like you might need it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Right... Because kissing another girl right after the girl I loved dumped me is going to make me feel better.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It might have!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You never know until you try...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No! Jessica, I can't believe you. That's so inappropriate!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ben, wait, I'm sorry. I didn't mean it! I just wanted to be your friend.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's not what friends do. I thought I could trust you. But now... I can't talk to you anymore.
Ben stands up, leaving Jessica alone on the porch.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `I was so close!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]I was so close!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Uh-oh, looks like Jessica's plan to get Ben for herself has hit a major snag!
You'd better try again, and see if you can get Jessica to kiss Ben at the right time!
Jessica holds back, hoping the right time to kiss Ben will come soon.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, I'm definitely going to be alone forever. How can I ever find someone like Denni?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I loved everything about her... Her short, petite frame...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Her witty sense of humor...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The way she can make everything sound sincere and sarcastic at the same time...
Some time later...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I love the way the sunlight makes her purple highlights glow...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The way she wears those vintage clothes like they were new...
And still later...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I especially love how she makes her vegan-friendly cupcakes...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How she knows the names of a million obscure bands...
And a couple hours later...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I think I've said enough about Denni. Now I'm finally ready...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Snore...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Wait, what? You're finally ready for what?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm ready to let her go. It's going to be hard, but I can do it.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's great news! Now that you're over Denni, you should start dating!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Dating? Oh, I'm not going to start dating.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What? But what about all those hot girls who might be interested in you?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, I'm flattered that you think these girls exist, but the truth is...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm never going to date anyone anymore!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That way I'll never have to get my heart broken again! Isn't that great?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And there's no way I'm going to change my mind!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Permanent single life, here I come!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I was so close! If only I'd kissed him earlier! Maybe things could have been different!
Uh-oh, looks like Jessica missed her window of opportunity!
You'd better try again, and see if you can get Jessica to kiss Ben at the right time!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Denni...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ben...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ben, I'm sorry!
Jessica leans in closer.
At that moment, Ben turns to face her. Their mouths are mere inches apart.
Jessica's eyes meet Ben's and, for a second, she sees a spark.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ben, I...
Jessica kisses Ben!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You can't blame yourself. You and Denni weren't exactly perfect together.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What about Thanksgiving week? She totally overreacted when all the cheerleaders came to sit with you. And she made a huge deal over her pie at your dinner.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And what about her Christmas gifts? They could've been better.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Actually, they ended up being really thoughtful. Just like she was.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh. You can't think like that. You have to move on.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Look, maybe we weren't perfect, but Denni meant everything to me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't know if I'll ever be able to go on. How do you even go about doing that?
Jessica holds back.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Just be patient for a little longer...
Jessica puts an arm around Ben.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, Ben. Everyone thinks they're going to be together with the first person they date.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And only a lucky few get to live happily ever after with that person.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: The truth is... Some things are just not meant to be.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But Denni was perfect. She was smart and funny. She had a great personality.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't get how our last argument turned out so badly. I wish I could have handled it better.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Then maybe we'd have stayed together.
Jessica stops herself from kissing Ben.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Slow and steady... Don't make a move on him too fast, Jessica...
Jessica moves closer to Ben.
As Ben watches Denni and Colt talk, his face loses color.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Denni... And Colt?
Ben spins around and walks straight out the door to the backyard.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Now's my chance to get close to him!
Jessica follows him.
On the porch out back, Jessica sits next to Ben.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hey, I'm... I'm so sorry you had to see that. I was just trying to get you to talk to her, and...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Every time I try to help you, it always seems to backfire.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, it's okay. It's not your fault. You've been a big help.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I feel just awful. Denni broke up with you, and then she cuddled up to Colt... It's like she's moved on already.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can't believe that she'd do something like that.

nodes.text: I don't know if I'll ever be able to go on. How do you even go about doing that?
Jessica leans forward to kiss Ben... And misses, planting a firm smooch on the railing of the porch!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ewww! Gross! Blech!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Pine wood does not taste good!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Jessica... Were you trying to kiss me?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It looked like you might need it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Right... Because kissing another girl right after the girl I loved dumped me is going to make me feel better.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It might have!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You never know until you try...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No! Jessica, I can't believe you. That's so inappropriate!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ben, wait, I'm sorry. I didn't mean it! I just wanted to be your friend.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's not what friends do. I thought I could trust you. But now... I can't talk to you anymore.
Ben stands up, leaving Jessica alone on the porch.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `I was so close!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]I was so close!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Uh-oh, looks like Jessica's plan to get Ben for herself has hit a major snag!
You'd better try again, and see if you can get Jessica to kiss Ben at the right time!
Jessica holds back, hoping the right time to kiss Ben will come soon.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, I'm definitely going to be alone forever. How can I ever find someone like Denni?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I loved everything about her... Her short, petite frame...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Her witty sense of humor...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The way she can make everything sound sincere and sarcastic at the same time...
Some time later...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I love the way the sunlight makes her purple highlights glow...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The way she wears those vintage clothes like they were new...
And still later...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I especially love how she makes her vegan-friendly cupcakes...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How she knows the names of a million obscure bands...
And a couple hours later...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I think I've said enough about Denni. Now I'm finally ready...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Snore...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Wait, what? You're finally ready for what?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm ready to let her go. It's going to be hard, but I can do it.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's great news! Now that you're over Denni, you should start dating!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Dating? Oh, I'm not going to start dating.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What? But what about all those hot girls who might be interested in you?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, I'm flattered that you think these girls exist, but the truth is...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm never going to date anyone anymore!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That way I'll never have to get my heart broken again! Isn't that great?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And there's no way I'm going to change my mind!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Permanent single life, here I come!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I was so close! If only I'd kissed him earlier! Maybe things could have been different!
Uh-oh, looks like Jessica missed her window of opportunity!
You'd better try again, and see if you can get Jessica to kiss Ben at the right time!
Later, at Hector's party...
Jessica and Nicole talk in a corner of the room as guests start to arrive.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: So... How's the master plan going? Is Denni still a problem?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yes, but not for long! Ben gave me the same special perfume he gave Denni, and Denni's mad at him.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Sigh... Boys are so dumb. Don't they know girls like unique gifts?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, it works for my purposes.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm putting them through the break up fight. They're going to realize that maybe they just don't understand each other at all.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: But what if it doesn't work?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh it'll work, Nicole. But if it doesn't... I have one more ace up my sleeve.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: What?
Jessica spots Colt at the drink table.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: He just arrived.
Jessica sidles up to Colt as she picks up a soda.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hey, haven't seen you around lately...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I haven't been around lately.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: The girls are really excited you're here. Everyone says you're still single... Is it true?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, but I'm not really looking.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, that's too bad. It doesn't have something to do with Denni, does it?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Maybe. Maybe not.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You know I heard she's not really that happy these days. At least, not with Ben.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh yeah?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Just thought you should know. They're... Fighting. It's pretty bad.
Jessica takes an innocent sip of her soda and walks back to Nicole.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I forgot how hot he is.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, you can enjoy it all evening. I need you to keep an eye on him. Text me every ten minutes to report what he's doing.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Got it!
Nicole whips out her cell phone and frantically presses some buttons!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Not right now! I...
Jessica's phone beeps. She glances at it.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: 'Looking hot'? Really?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: That's what he's doing!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Why do you need me to keep tabs on him, anyway?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: If things are going too well with Ben and Denni, I need him to be around to... Throw things into chaos.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Now get over there and stay on him!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Don't have to ask me twice.
Nicole walks over to Colt.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: So... Where have you been all this time?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Here and there. I've had some crazy adventures up at Spartan Academy...
Jessica leaves and looks around for Denni. She spots Denni heading into the kitchen.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hi, Denni...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What do you want? Come to talk about how happy you about Ben's wonderful Secret Santa gift?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I just came here to apologize.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No you didn't. I know what you're up to.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You... You do?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, I know exactly why you're here.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You're here to tell me to talk to Ben.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I... Is that so wrong?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No, but I already know what I'm supposed to do. Just... Not what I'm supposed to say.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I was so upset when he gave you that gift, I couldn't think straight. Was I wrong to get mad at him?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No! What Ben did was totally...
On the porch out back, Jessica sits next to Ben.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hey, I'm... I'm so sorry you had to see that. I was just trying to get you to talk to her, and...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Every time I try to help you, it always seems to backfire.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, it's okay. It's not your fault. You've been a big help.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I feel just awful. Denni broke up with you, and then she cuddled up to Colt... It's like she's moved on already.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can't believe that she'd do something like that.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I hate to point this out, but she just did.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sometimes, you think you know somebody when you really don't know them at all.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But I can't believe it's over. Denni and I were so perfect together.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And after the evening we had last night... I thought we were really going to be together forever.
Ben pushes Jessica away and stares at her. Jessica feigns shock.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ben, you... You totally kissed me!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Is that how that happened?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'll admit... I kissed you back. I know it's not the right time for this, but... I have feelings for you, Ben. I like you. A lot.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's like that episode of 'My Neighbor is a Girl!' where a guy realizes that the girl he needs to be with is right next to him all along!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I didn't realize it until now, but we have something really special between us.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I feel the same way, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, you're fun and nice, and you seem to care about what I like. I consider you a really good friend.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Just a friend?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Look, Jessica, it's not a good time. I love Denni, and she just broke my heart.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And here's where I seal the deal by being understanding...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, I didn't forget about Denni! I want to respect both of you.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: The relationship you had with Denni was special. It'll take you some time to get over that.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And as for 'us'... I don't want to be a rebound relationship to you. I want you to take some time for yourself and think about what you want.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Maybe someday, if you're ready... We can talk about 'us'.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm just going to go home... And think.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Good night, Jessica.
Ben lets himself out the back gate of Hector's yard. Jessica watches him walk off...
And smiles.
You helped Jessica break Ben and Denni up, and you managed to get Jessica that sweet Secret Santa kiss!
All in all, you did an amazing job! Well, at least from Jessica's perspective!

nodes.text: How can I save this?

nodes.text: I... I'm sorry, Ben. I saw you were feeling down...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, maybe I was teaching you a lesson about how Denni's not the only girl you should ever be with!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You've been trying to get with me?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...Is this what it's all been about?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Have you been trying to get Denni to break up with me?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No way! Do you really think I'd do something like that?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I didn't think you were capable of that, but... You know what? That makes so much sense...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh-oh.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You were the one who told me that giving you Denni's perfume wasn't a big deal...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And the only reason I listened to you was because I figured you had more experience with relationships.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But you were trying to get me to blow it with Denni!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What have I done? I need to find Denni and apologize to her.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And maybe if she listens to the truth, she'll take me back.
Ben turns and strides purposefully into the party.
Jessica runs after him into the kitchen.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Has anyone seen Denni?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: She's still on the porch, man.
Ben turns towards the front door, and Jessica jumps in front of him.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ben, wait, you don't want to do this!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Because...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Because I'll ruin you!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Get out of the way.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm not afraid of you, Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm going to clear things up with Denni, and then people will know what you've done...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How you tried to break me and Denni apart!
Everyone turns to stare at Jessica. She can hear the whispers fly around the room.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I... I know when I'm not wanted!
Jessica flings the door open and runs out!
Oh no! Ben figured out Jessica's master plan and exposed her? This isn't how things can end for Jessica!

What? Surprised to see me?
Yeah, I am! I thought you left. For good. What are you doing here?
Or do you just happen to show up whenever Ben and I are having trouble?

If I thought you'd be here, I wouldn't have shown.

...Right.

I might be mad at him, but I'm still not going to let you call him that.
Hey, he earned the name. It was the guy's own poor life choice to wear something that criss-crosses.
So, I guess things aren't going well if you're this mad at him?
I don't know if I should tell you...
Colt puts a hand on her shoulder.
You can tell me anything. I do care how you are.
Is he treating you okay? Are you happy?
He treats me fine. But we got into a huge fight. And I may have said something that I regret.
What'd you say?
I might have told him we shouldn't be together anymore.
Ouch. Harsh. How'd he take the breakup?
I didn't break up with him. I said we `shouldn't` be together, not that we aren't.
You might want to make sure `he` knows that.
I'm sure he does.
Well, I didn't.
You don't think I've messed things up, do you?
Colt steps close and hugs Denni.
I didn't say that. Look, I'm sure everything's going to be fine.

I can't leave things like this between us. I... I have to go.

Oh, okay. I guess I'll drop by his house and...
Denni's phone rings. She pulls it from her pocket and quickly puts it to her ear.
Hello, Ben?
Nope. This is Raven. Is Ben your new boyfriend?
Something like that. What's going on, Raven?
Mom wants you home right away.
What? She told me I could be out until 10PM.
She changed her mind. You know how Mitch always wants to get to the airport three hours early. We decided to leave now.
Okay. I'll be home in five. See you.
Denni hangs up.
I guess I won't stop by Ben's.
I'll just call him and fix everything while I'm on the road. It'll be okay... Right?

nodes.subtitle: Can you help Jessica break Ben and Denni up?

nodes.text: It's the last day of school before the Christmas break!
Jessica is managing the cheerleaders as they set equipment up for their performance at the Secret Santa assembly.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Amanda and Maria! You'll be standing next to me during the performance, so limber up!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Keith and Hector, the light machine should aim at the center, so I'm in the spotlight.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: $ZOE, go fluff all the pom-poms in the locker room and then bring them out here!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Nicole, make-up! Now!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Coming right up. How do you want me to do it?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Do it party style. I have to look extra hot today. It's important.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's the last time Ben will see me before Christmas break. I have to leave him with a good impression.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So I'm performing in the center of our cheer today. That's why we're spelling out my name, remember?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And second, after we cheer, everyone gets to meet their `Secret Santa` for the final gift exchange.
nodes.text_bbcode: And second, after we cheer, everyone gets to meet their [color=#3b78e2][i]Secret Santa[/i][/color] for the final gift exchange.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ugh, I'm so not looking forward to that. My gifts are just notes speculating on Santa's real identity...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I think my person might have misunderstood the activity...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Too bad for you! Ben is my Secret Santa. I can't wait to fawn over the gift he's getting me today.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: How do you know he's your Secret Santa?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Because I rigged it. Justin left the stupid Secret Santa assignments with Erik, and that nerd is way too easy to distract.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: All I had to do was tell him that Justin wanted to talk with him about how much their friendship means to him.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I can't believe that worked! So you fixed the list and made Ben your Secret Santa?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Of course! I have to be constantly on his mind if he's going to dump Little Miss Purple Hair and become `my` boyfriend.
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course! I have to be constantly on his mind if he's going to dump Little Miss Purple Hair and become [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] boyfriend.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And judging by the gifts he's been getting me, he's going to be such a good boyfriend.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I mean, come on, the first three seasons of 'Boyfriend Switch'? I practically love him already.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ooo, have you gotten to the part where Candi and Quendra switch, so Candi has to date Chad, and Quendra has to date The Incident?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh my god! Talk about love at first `bite!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh my god! Talk about love at first [color=#3b78e2][i]bite![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Anyway, the plan is, I meet up with Ben at the big Secret Santa reveal, look all hot, and wait for him to go after me.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: What about Denni?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh, don't talk to me about Denni. I can't believe they're still together. Did you see what she got him for Christmas?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I saw her give him spoons! Who gives a guy spoons?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I wouldn't give my grandma spoons, and soup's the only thing she can eat!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Then you should probably get her a spoon...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: The point is... Denni's an anti-social loser, and she couldn't give him a good gift if it wrapped `itself` in front of her.
nodes.text_bbcode: The point is... Denni's an anti-social loser, and she couldn't give him a good gift if it wrapped [color=#3b78e2][i]itself[/i][/color] in front of her.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I just hope it reminds Ben they're so not right for each other.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I don't know... You think he's going to dump her just because she gave some bad gifts?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: He will with a little help from me.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Get this... Last night when Ben called me to ask for advice on Denni's Christmas present, I told him to knit a sweater! Denni will hate it!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I just need one more big thing to go wrong with the two of them, and then Denni won't be a problem at all.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ooh, devious. Sounds like your plan's coming together perfectly!
Nicole finishes Jessica's makeup just as Maria walks up to them.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hey, Jessica. Everything's ready. It's going to look amazing!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Awesome job, girls!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: ...And Keith and Hector.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We have a couple more minutes before the bell rings, so keep going over the routine in your head while we wait!
The cheerleaders sit down on the bleachers to wait.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: So what are you going to do after school gets out?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh, same thing I do after `every` finals week... And every study week... And every week with 7 days...
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, same thing I do after [color=#e23b3b][i]every[/i][/color] finals week... And every study week... And every week with 7 days...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm throwing a huge party!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You coming?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: That depends... Who else is going?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Everyone in school!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And, uh, I'm thinking about inviting Colt, but I'm not sure that's a good idea...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Colt? Did you say Colt?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh, yeah. Even though he left us for Spartan Academy, we're still cool. He's on winter break, so I thought it'd be cool to see him.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This is perfect! Colt is Ben and Denni's biggest weakness! Ben hates him, and Denni's always kissing him when it's inappropriate! This might be the last big thing I need!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I think you should totally invite Colt.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But inviting him might cause some awkward situations for other people...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Like Ben. And Denni. And Sam. And Spencer. And maybe even Taylor, I don't know, did they have a thing?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Aw, come on, Hector. You have to.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Because...

nodes.text: And second, after we cheer, everyone gets to meet their `Secret Santa` for the final gift exchange.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ugh, I'm so not looking forward to that. My gifts are just notes speculating on Santa's real identity...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I think my person might have misunderstood the activity...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Too bad for you! Ben is my Secret Santa. I can't wait to fawn over the gift he's getting me today.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: How do you know he's your Secret Santa?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Because I rigged it. Justin left the stupid Secret Santa assignments with Erik, and that nerd is way too easy to distract.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: All I had to do was tell him that Justin wanted to talk with him about how much their friendship means to him.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I can't believe that worked! So you fixed the list and made Ben your Secret Santa?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Of course! I have to be constantly on his mind if he's going to dump Little Miss Purple Hair and become `my` boyfriend.
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course! I have to be constantly on his mind if he's going to dump Little Miss Purple Hair and become [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] boyfriend.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And judging by the gifts he's been getting me, he's going to be such a good boyfriend.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I mean, come on, the first three seasons of 'Boyfriend Switch'? I practically love him already.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ooo, have you gotten to the part where Candi and Quendra switch, so Candi has to date Chad, and Quendra has to date The Incident?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh my god! Talk about love at first `bite!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh my god! Talk about love at first [color=#3b78e2][i]bite![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Anyway, the plan is, I meet up with Ben at the big Secret Santa reveal, look all hot, and wait for him to go after me.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: What about Denni?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh, don't talk to me about Denni. I can't believe they're still together. Did you see what she got him for Christmas?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I saw her give him spoons! Who gives a guy spoons?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I wouldn't give my grandma spoons, and soup's the only thing she can eat!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Then you should probably get her a spoon...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: The point is... Denni's an anti-social loser, and she couldn't give him a good gift if it wrapped `itself` in front of her.
nodes.text_bbcode: The point is... Denni's an anti-social loser, and she couldn't give him a good gift if it wrapped [color=#3b78e2][i]itself[/i][/color] in front of her.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I just hope it reminds Ben they're so not right for each other.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I don't know... You think he's going to dump her just because she gave some bad gifts?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: He will with a little help from me.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Get this... Last night when Ben called me to ask for advice on Denni's Christmas present, I told him to knit a sweater! Denni will hate it!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I just need one more big thing to go wrong with the two of them, and then Denni won't be a problem at all.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ooh, devious. Sounds like your plan's coming together perfectly!
Nicole finishes Jessica's makeup just as Maria walks up to them.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hey, Jessica. Everything's ready. It's going to look amazing!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Awesome job, girls!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: ...And Keith and Hector.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We have a couple more minutes before the bell rings, so keep going over the routine in your head while we wait!
The cheerleaders sit down on the bleachers to wait.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: So what are you going to do after school gets out?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh, same thing I do after `every` finals week... And every study week... And every week with 7 days...
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, same thing I do after [color=#e23b3b][i]every[/i][/color] finals week... And every study week... And every week with 7 days...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm throwing a huge party!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You coming?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: That depends... Who else is going?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Everyone in school!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And, uh, I'm thinking about inviting Colt, but I'm not sure that's a good idea...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Colt? Did you say Colt?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh, yeah. Even though he left us for Spartan Academy, we're still cool. He's on winter break, so I thought it'd be cool to see him.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This is perfect! Colt is Ben and Denni's biggest weakness! Ben hates him, and Denni's always kissing him when it's inappropriate! This might be the last big thing I need!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I think you should totally invite Colt.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But inviting him might cause some awkward situations for other people...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Like Ben. And Denni. And Sam. And Spencer. And maybe even Taylor, I don't know, did they have a thing?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Aw, come on, Hector. You have to.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Because...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, I'm sorry! I don't know what happened just a few minutes ago, but I never meant to hurt you.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I know that now. And I don't want to be mad at you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, I'm sorry! I don't know what happened this morning, but I never meant to hurt you.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I realized something while we were apart... I don't want to be mad at you.
